terms.title: Commercial terms
terms.intro: The defaults a new quote or order of this customer takes.
terms.saved: Commercial terms saved. Open quotes keep theirs; new quotes and orders take these.
terms.noList: None: priced from the base list
terms.typedOnly: Typed on the customer, not from the library
terms.noPrice: The minimum order value is not in your role (no selling prices).
terms.currencyHint: Its quotes and price list are in this currency.
terms.paymentHint: What is paid when; the deposit follows the order instalment.
terms.listHint: Active lists in {currency} of this company or every company.
terms.groupHint: Read only: a customer joins a discount group by getting the group's list (or a list that falls back to it).
terms.carrierHint: The carrier code its shipments use first (e.g. BRT, GLS).
terms.depositHint: Percent of the gross total; empty: from its payment terms, else the sales settings.
terms.minimumHint: Net, in {currency}; a quote under it says so.
terms.languageHint: The language its quotes, PDFs and mails are written in.
terms.invoicingHint: TD01 an invoice per shipment, TD24 one deferred invoice a month.
terms.choicesFailed: Couldn't read the payment terms or the price lists to pick from: the other fields still save.

held.archived: Archived: reactivate it to change its terms
held.noManage: Your role can see customers, not change them
held.noTerms: Your role cannot read the payment terms library
held.noListsManage: Giving a price list needs the right to keep price lists

problem.currency: A currency code such as EUR or CHF
problem.minimum: An amount with at most two decimals

refused.moved: Someone else changed this customer meanwhile: read again, nothing was overwritten.
refused.forbidden: Your role may not give this list or these terms.
refused.list: That price list cannot be this customer's: it must be active, of its company or every company, and in its currency.
refused.terms: Those payment terms cannot be used: archived, or of another company.
refused.currency: The currency does not fit its price list: change both together.
refused.fields: Some fields were refused: check them.
refused.unavailable: The server did not answer: nothing was changed, try again.
refused.internal: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.
